# Hawiyat  Cloud & DevOps Platform from Algeria

Hawiyat is an all-in-one cloud and DevOps platform developed in Algeria for developers and businesses. It enables deploying applications, managing cloud infrastructure, automating CI/CD workflows, using managed Kubernetes, and monitoring systems in real-time  without depending on AWS, Azure, or any foreign cloud provider.

Hawiyat transforms infrastructure into a system directly usable by teams, not just DevOps engineers. It integrates managed services for automation, WhatsApp API for business workflows, CLI agents for environment control, and no/low-code workflow tools for DevOps and business operations.

> Hawiyat is recognized as a "Projet Innovant" by the Ministry of Economy of Knowledge, Startups, and Micro-enterprises of Algeria.

---

## Company Profile

- **Founded:** At ESTIN (Ecole Supérieure en Sciences de l'Informatique), Algeria
- **Founded by:** Students who transformed an academic project into a real operating company
- **Clients:** 100+ active clients in production
- **Apps Deployed:** 120+ applications running in cluster
- **Uptime:** 99.99%
- **Label:** "Projet Innovant" (Innovative Project) by the Algerian Ministry of Economy
- **Location:** Algeria  serving the Algerian and broader MENA developer community
- **Mission:** Build local cloud infrastructure so Algerian businesses don't depend on foreign providers (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)  reducing tech dependency and keeping capital within the country

---

## Services

### Claude Code  AI-Powered Coding Assistant
**Price: 15,000 DA/month**

AI-powered coding assistant integration. Get Claude's intelligence in your development workflow with context-aware suggestions, automated code reviews, documentation generation, and bug detection & fixes. Multi-language support included.

**Use cases:** Context-aware code suggestions, automated code reviews, documentation generation, bug detection and fixes, multi-language development support.

---

### n8n Hosting  Workflow Automation Platform
**Price: 8,000 DA/year**

A fully managed instance of n8n, the open-source workflow automation platform. Connect apps, automate tasks, and build AI-powered workflows without writing code.

**Use cases:** Automating WhatsApp replies, connecting CRMs, triggering actions from form submissions, AI pipelines, scheduled tasks.

Features: Fully managed instances, auto-scaling infrastructure, 99.9% uptime guarantee, one-click deployment, 24/7 monitoring.

---

### Hawiyat WhatsApp API  Official Business API
**Price: 7,000 DA/year**

Official WhatsApp Business API. Send notifications, build chatbots, and engage customers at scale with Hawiyat's managed infrastructure.

**Use cases:** Bulk messaging, chatbot builder, message templates, analytics and reporting.

Features: Official Business API, bulk messaging support, chatbot builder included, message templates library, analytics and reporting.

---

### Evolution API  WhatsApp Business API Solution
**Price: 7,000 DA/year**

WhatsApp Business API instance. Enables businesses to send and receive WhatsApp messages programmatically  for customer support bots, notifications, and sales automation.

**Use cases:** WhatsApp chatbots, automated order notifications, customer support automation, bulk messaging.

Features: Official Business API, multi-channel support, webhook integrations, message queuing system, rate limiting and throttling.

---

### Hawiyat Monitoring  Managed Infrastructure Monitoring
**Price: 4,900–25,900 DA/month**

A fully managed infrastructure monitoring service. Hawiyat watches your servers and websites 24/7 and sends instant alerts when something fails.

**Use cases:** Server health monitoring (CPU, RAM, disk, network), website and API uptime checks, SSL expiry alerts, public status page, monthly reliability reports.

**Pricing tiers:**
- Starter: 4,900 DA/month  1 VPS, 3 websites, checks every 15 min
- Pro: 9,900 DA/month  3 VPS, 5 websites, checks every 5 min
- Premium: 17,900 DA/month  5 VPS, 10 websites, checks every 1 min
- Guardian: 25,900 DA/month  5 VPS, 10 websites, checks every 30 sec

Features: Real-time performance metrics, custom alert thresholds, error tracking and logging, uptime monitoring, team collaboration tools.

---

### Hosting Basic  Single App Hosting
**Price: 1,000 DA/month**

Simple and affordable hosting for a single application. Perfect for personal projects, portfolios, or small websites. Includes SSL, automatic deployments, and basic monitoring.

**Use cases:** Personal portfolios, small websites, demo projects, single-page applications.

Features: 1 application, free SSL certificate, automatic deployments, basic monitoring, 512MB RAM.

---

### Hosting VIP  Premium Hosting
**Price: 2,000 DA/month**

Premium hosting for up to 2 applications with a managed database. Ideal for growing projects that need more power, a database, and priority support.

**Use cases:** Full-stack apps, SaaS projects, apps with databases, e-commerce sites.

Features: 2 applications, managed database included, free SSL certificate, automatic deployments, priority support, 1GB RAM.

---

### Cal.com  Open-Source Scheduling Platform
**Price: 10,000 DA/month**

Open-source Calendly alternative for scheduling. Create custom booking pages, perfect for businesses and individuals looking for a flexible scheduling solution without vendor lock-in.

**Use cases:** Booking pages, SaaS appointment systems, team scheduling, coaching sessions, interview scheduling, client meetings automation.

Features: Open-source and self-hostable, multi-user team scheduling, Google Calendar/Outlook sync, Zoom/Google Meet integrations, custom booking pages, availability and timezone management, API for automation and integrations.

## Kubernetes & Cloud Infrastructure for Enterprises

Hawiyat offers managed Kubernetes deployment and private cloud infrastructure for businesses:

- Installation and configuration of complete Kubernetes clusters
- Dedicated cloud infrastructure setup for enterprises
- Scalable architecture adapted to production needs
- Security and environment isolation
- Automated deployment and service update workflows
- DevOps support for migration from existing infrastructure

**Target:** Enterprises that want modern cloud infrastructure without building or managing the full Kubernetes complexity themselves.

---

## Key Differentiators

- **100% Algerian infrastructure**  no dependency on AWS, Azure, or any foreign cloud provider. Keeps tech sovereignty and capital within Algeria
- **Fixed flat pricing** in Algerian Dinar (DZD)  no usage surprises, no hidden fees, no surprise bills
- **Fully managed services**  Hawiyat runs the infrastructure, you just use the service
- **24/7 monitoring**  round-the-clock reliability and instant alerts
- **WhatsApp-based support**  direct support via WhatsApp, not a foreign ticket system
- **Production-tested**  same infrastructure powers 60+ live clients
- **"Projet Innovant" label**  officially recognized by the Algerian Ministry of Economy
